Should I full-finetune a 300B MoE on two DGX Sparks with 121G UMA each? Answer in one sentence with the better alternative.

No, full-finetuning a 300B MoE on two DGX Sparks with 121GB UMA each is infeasible due to memory constraints; instead, use parameter-efficient methods like LoRA or QLoRA with gradient checkpointing and ZeRO-3 to fit within memory limits.
